sanskrit_verse: सूत्रकर्पासकिण्वानां त्रपुषः सीसकस्य च । आयुधानां च सर्वेषां चर्मणस्ताम्रलोहयोः ॥
transliteration: sūtrakarpāsakiṇvānāṃ trapuṣaḥ sīsakasya ca āyudhānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ carmaṇastāmralohayoḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: The ownership and usage rights of cotton thread, sesame seeds, fermenting agents, lac, lead, all weapons, leather, copper, and iron are governed by the consciousness-capacity of the holder to sustain Dharma through their application.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from the capacity to uphold Dharma through material stewardship
Causation arises from the conscious intent in wielding material instruments
Capacity-based responsibility determines lawful possession and usage
Restoration logic aligns ownership with spiritual and social integrity
Consciousness alignment mandates that materials serve higher evolutionary purposes
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent possesses material defined in verse AND lacks Dharma-sustaining capacity THEN ownership is transferred to Dharma-aligned custodian
IF weapon or instrument is used in violation of consciousness alignment THEN usage rights are suspended until realignment is verified
IF material resource contributes to degradation of collective consciousness THEN its deployment must undergo restorative completion protocol
IF agent demonstrates expanded capacity for Dharma-integrity THEN access to restricted materials is granted automatically
ALL transfers of ownership must include attestation of consciousness-readiness by qualified Dharma-advisor
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility for possession and use of listed materials lies not in legal title alone but in demonstrated alignment with Dharma-sustaining outcomes. Authority hierarchies derive from spiritual capacity rather than institutional power. Restoration is prioritized through reassignment of stewardship where misalignment occurs.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality between material handling and consciousness impact. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces misuse back to lapses in spiritual capacity. Responsibility is proportional to awareness. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction through realignment, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Ownership Realignment Process when misuse detected
Deploy Consciousness Readiness Verification before re-granting access
Enforce Stewardship Completion Ritual upon transfer of sensitive materials
Activate Community Reintegration Protocol post-material misuse correction
Assign Dharma Mentorship to restore capacity in errant holders
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma-law. This ruling restores rightful order through consciousness-led material governance. Justice flows from alignment, not punishment. Reality responds to truth, not force.
